name: What are the common pitfalls when relisting an expired luxury property?

mainEntity.name: What are the common pitfalls when relisting an expired luxury property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common pitfalls when relisting an expired luxury property include using the same marketing approach that failed previously, setting an unrealistic price, or neglecting necessary repairs or staging. A practical tradeoff is investing in professional staging or minor renovations versus a potentially longer time on the market. Kelby Contreras emphasizes avoiding these by conducting a fresh market analysis, proposing strategic updates, and implementing a refined marketing plan, especially critical in discerning markets such as Pinecrest or Coconut Grove.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common pitfalls include repeating past mistakes in marketing or pricing, or neglecting repairs. A practical tradeoff is investing in staging versus a longer market time.
